title: Event Presence Index
description: Give it a company domain. It returns the third party conferences and trade shows that company publicly says it attends, with a year for each where one can be resolved. It finds events for roughly 2 companies in 10, and every event it returns is real.

domain.title: Company domain
domain.description: A single company domain, for example 6sense.com. Protocol and path are stripped.

company_name.title: Company name
company_name.description: Improves matching when the brand differs from the domain stem, for example Gong for gong.io. Derived from the domain when left empty.

years.title: Years to include
years.description: Comma separated, for example 2025,2026. Events dated outside this set are still returned and flagged. Sent as a string so it works from Clay.

include_own_events.title: Include the company's own events
include_own_events.description: Reports whether the company runs its own conference as a separate field. It is never mixed into the attendance list.

max_queries.title: Max search queries
max_queries.description: Between 1 and 5. Each query costs roughly 0.8 seconds plus a 1.3 second pause. 2 is the measured sweet spot: search engines refuse a third query from the same container almost every time, and the third query added no events the first two did not already find. Sent as a string so it works from Clay.

skipCache.title: Skip the cache
skipCache.description: false uses the 21 day result cache. true forces a fresh look.

source_tag.title: Source Tag
source_tag.description: Internal attribution tag set by Mamba Labs on published task examples. Not required, and nothing depends on it. Leave it empty.
